questions.question: Revenue expenditure minus revenue receipts is ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**revenue deficit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Revenue deficit** arises when a **government's revenue expenditure** surpasses its revenue receipts.
 
• Revenue expenditure encompasses spending on items like salaries, pensions, and interest payments, while revenue receipts comprise income from taxes and fees.
 
• This deficit serves as a crucial gauge of the government's fiscal condition, with elevated deficits potentially triggering issues like inflation and economic instability.
 
• Various strategies exist to alleviate revenue deficits, including augmenting revenue receipts through tax hikes or fee adjustments, as well as curbing expenditure by implementing cost-saving measures or terminating certain programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] 

**Important Points__**

 
• **A budget deficit** occurs when a government's total expenditures surpass its total revenues over a specified period, usually a fiscal year.
 
• This signifies that the government is spending more funds than it is generating through diverse channels like taxes, fees, and other revenue sources.
 
• Revenue receipts denote the income a business garners from its routine operations.
 
• They are recurrent and have an impact on the business's profit and loss as reflected in the income statement.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT one of the direct outcomes that can be attributed to a good industrial sector?

options.text: Provision of mass consumption manufactured goods

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Doubling of farmers’ income**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Doubling of farmers' income,"** is not directly related to the** industrial sector**. 
 
• Increasing farmers' income typically involves agricultural policies, improvements in farming techniques, infrastructure development in rural areas, and market reforms to ensure fair prices for agricultural products. 
 
• While industrialization may indirectly contribute to overall economic growth and development, specifically doubling farmers' income is not a direct outcome attributed to the industrial sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png]

• The industrial sector primarily focuses on manufacturing goods and providing employment opportunities in factories and production facilities.
 
• The outcomes typically associated with a strong industrial sector include:
 
 
• **Provision of relatively stable employment: **A robust industrial sector often leads to the creation of jobs in manufacturing industries, providing stable employment opportunities for workers.
 
• **Promotion of modernization: **Industrialization drives technological advancements and promotes modernization by encouraging the adoption of new production techniques, machinery, and processes.
 
• **Provision of mass consumption manufactured goods:** A well-developed industrial sector produces a wide range of manufactured goods, including consumer products, which are essential for meeting the demands of the population and driving economic growth through increased consumption.

questions.question: Which of the following is the most widespread forest type in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical Deciduous Forests**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tropical deciduous forests,** also referred to as **monsoon forests,** thrive in regions receiving an annual rainfall ranging from 70 to 200 cm.
 
• These forests exhibit lush greenery and dense vegetation during the wet summer months but transform during the dry winters, characterized by leaf shedding and a drier landscape.
 
• Found in regions such as India, northern Australia, and central America, tropical deciduous forests are particularly widespread in India, covering vast areas including Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Orissa, and parts of Maharashtra.
 
• In India, these forests hold significant economic importance as they serve as abundant sources of valuable timber species like teak, sal, sandalwood, and rosewood.
 
• These trees are extensively utilized in the lumber industry for various purposes such as construction, railway infrastructure, and furniture manufacturing. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Littoral and swamp forests, commonly referred to as wetland forests, thrive in coastal regions, along seashores, creeks, river estuaries, and deltas. They can also be observed at the edges of swampy islands and along sandy beaches.
 
• **Tropical thorn forests, **characterized by scrub-like vegetation, are typically found in desert regions. These forests are prevalent in tropical and subtropical areas and thrive in semi-arid regions receiving less than 70 cm of annual rainfall.
 
• **Montane ecosystems** are situated on mountain slopes, where the alpine climate significantly influences the ecosystem. As elevation increases, temperatures drop, leading to distinct stratification within the ecosystem due to varying environmental conditions.

questions.question: What is the number of players in a Kho Kho team?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**12**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A Kho Kho team **comprises **12 players**, with **nine players** participating in a game while the remaining three serve as substitutes.
 
• During a game, the chasing team sends nine players onto the field who assume a kneeling position. Meanwhile, the defending team, comprised of the remaining three players, aims to evade being touched by members of the opposing team.
 
• Each match consists of two innings, with each team allotted seven minutes for both chasing and defending.
 
• This format allows for strategic gameplay as teams alternate between chasing and defending roles to score points and outmanoeuvre their opponents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png]

• An **externality** refers to the occurrence of a cost or benefit resulting from the actions of one party, yet borne or enjoyed financially by another.
 
• These effects may impact individuals or entire organizations and can be classified as either private or societal.
 
• **Positive externalities** arise when they provide a benefit to a third party. For instance, the construction of infrastructure like flyovers or highways can decrease transportation expenses and travel duration for users.
 
• Conversely, negative externalities occur when they impose a cost on third parties. For example, the construction of roads may lead to erosion and chemical runoff, subsequently polluting water sources downstream.

• This measure, also known as nominal or money national income, reflects the actual purchasing power of a currency at a particular juncture.
 
• Constant prices, representing real value, are adjusted for price fluctuations concerning a baseline or reference point.
 
• In contrast, current prices, denoting nominal value, are those prevailing at a specific moment.
 
• Real national income offers a more precise evaluation of the real shifts in production and economic activity over time, enhancing the accuracy of comparisons.

questions.question: Which of the following is the proper number of electrons in 1 A of current?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**6.25 × 10¹⁸**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The proper number of electrons in 1 ampere (1 A) of current can be calculated using the elementary charge, which is the charge carried by a single electron.
 
• The elementary charge is approximately 1.602×10−¹⁹ coulombs.
 
• To find the number of electrons, we need to divide the total charge (which is 1 coulomb for 1 ampere of current) by the elementary charge: 

**Number of electrons= Elementary charge/Total charge ​**

Number of electrons = 1 C/1.602×10−¹⁹ C/electron

Number of electrons = 1 C/1.602×10−¹⁹ C/electron

Number of electrons ≈ 6.25 × 10¹⁸ electrons

So, the proper number of electrons in 1 ampere of current is approximately **6.25 × 1018 electrons**.

• This framework was subsequently adopted by the Central Statistical Office (CSO) during its base revision in** January 2015**.
 
• **Gross Value Added (GVA) **is defined as the value of output minus the value of intermediate consumption.
 
• It represents the contribution of both labour and capital to the production process.
 
• When taxes on products (net of subsidies on products) are included, the sum of value added across all resident units yields the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of a nation.
 
• Hence, the GDP of any country reflects the total Gross Value Added (GVA) across all sectors of the economy during the specified year, adjusting for taxes and subsidies, without accounting for capital consumption or depreciation. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• In India, the estimation of **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** is undertaken by the** Central Statistical Office (CSO).**
 
• The Ministry of Finance utilizes the GDP figures (at current prices) to establish fiscal targets by the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act of 2003 and its associated regulations.
 
• As part of this process, the Ministry of Finance formulates its projections regarding GDP for the upcoming two years while delineating future fiscal objectives.
 
• Gross Value Added (GVA) at basic prices is delineated as the output valued at basic prices minus the intermediate consumption valued at purchasers' prices. In this context, GVA is identified by the price at which the output is appraised.
